full_details: The almanac had the full moon against the eighth. The three sockets from last night stood by the closed sheet, and you added no line. At dinner Alse brought two pence of cloves. Mistress Ansell saw the sockets and saved her count. The loaf was still a full thumb short. Board was threepence. At two you were the old Roman again, and Richard Cowley offered to take the part. You kept the gown. John said the tooth had been at you since the ninth of September, four weeks as of yesterday. Humphrey had read the Rose bill, Crack Me. You did not go. You were off in the fourth, as on Monday. You came home with the one candle you had asked for, and you did not put the moon in the book.
one_sentence: You paid two pence for cloves, kept the old Roman in Titus, and looked at the full moon.
title: A full moon, two pence, and the same Roman
